title: Input that an interface rejects before scanning
summary: Input an interface declares invalid (bytes that are not UTF-8, or a string chunk cut inside a surrogate pair).
rationale: An expected rejection is neither a detection nor a miss: it has its own denominator and no outcome.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: a rejection is recorded as input validity, not as a true or false negative.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
